guide.summary: Production app for outside customers (app review).
guide.verdict: No easy case: every production setup needs pre-approval plus a security review, with no documented duration, and yearly re-reviews.

composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth for Gusto. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio lists no managed OAuth app for Gusto, so you must register your own application and supply its client ID and client secret in a Composio auth config.

scenarios.label: Production app for outside customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects Gusto accounts of customers outside your company, directly or through an approved Unified API partner.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count and security documents to gather, not measured

waiting.basis: No review duration is documented in the Gusto docs found.

scenarios.approval: Production Pre-Approval by the Partnerships team, then a Security Review by the GRC team; scopes are assigned during review; reviews repeat annually.

modifiers.note: Assigned scopes are enforced in production only after approval.
Annual security reviews; extra reviews when integration changes.

extras: Assigned scopes are enforced in production only after
Annual security reviews; extra reviews when integration changes.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation
prerequisites.detail: Prepare audits such as SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS, plus penetration test reports and security policies. Without a formal audit, Gusto asks about controls like MFA and encryption.

prerequisites.title: Security and incident contacts
prerequisites.detail: Provide a security contact and an incident response contact, each with name, title and email.

prerequisites.title: Developer Portal application
prerequisites.detail: Your client ID and client secret come from the application you register in the Gusto developer portal.

steps.title: Register Gusto application
steps.detail: Create the application in the Gusto developer portal and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Test scopes in demo environment
steps.detail: Build and test against the demo environment with the scopes for your use case, keeping them to the minimum needed.
steps.done_when: Your integration works within the intended scopes in demo.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your Gusto app.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and the redirect URI is registered in Gusto.

steps.title: Draft security review package
steps.detail: Collect and organize audits, pen test reports, policies and contacts into the form Gusto asks for.
steps.done_when: All requested documents and contacts are ready.

steps.title: File Production Pre-Approval
steps.detail: Submit the application with company and security details, then take no further action until Gusto responds.

steps.title: Wait for pre-approval and review
steps.detail: The Partnerships team reviews first, then the GRC team runs the Security Review. Answer any extra information requests quickly, since the review is on hold meanwhile.
steps.done_when: Gusto emails next steps or notifies your Unified API platform of approval.

traps.title: Gusto's API rate limit is 200 requests per minute
traps.detail: Gusto's API rate limit is 200 requests per minute per OAuth grant (60-second rolling window), with 429 responses beyond that. The page does not state a different limit for unreviewed or test apps.

traps.title: Review pauses on information requests
traps.detail: Gusto may ask for extra information and puts the Security Review on hold until you reply.

traps.title: Scopes are assigned, not chosen
traps.detail: Gusto assigns scopes based on your use case, and calls outside them are rejected in production. Changes can be requested only after release to production.

traps.title: Yearly and change-triggered re-review
traps.detail: Continued API access depends on annual security reviews, and changes to your integration may trigger new ones.

blockers.what_it_means: The call is outside the scopes Gusto assigned to your app.
blockers.what_to_do: Check granted scopes in the Developer Portal and contact Gusto support to request changes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare the failing calls against the granted scopes.
